title: OmniVia Core Application Contract v1 - version and capability negotiation
description: Version windows, deprecation notices, upgrade state, and capability negotiation. This document declares no root type; it is a definition container only.

VersionWindow.title: VersionWindow
VersionWindow.description: An inclusive range of contract versions a peer supports.

Deprecation.title: Deprecation
Deprecation.description: A stable, citable notice that something in the contract is going away.

id.description: Stable deprecation identifier. Never reused for a different deprecation.

since.description: Contract version in which the deprecation was announced.

removal.description: Contract version in which removal is planned, when known.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Not a stable interface.

UpgradeState.title: UpgradeState
UpgradeState.description: Where the peer stands relative to a required or offered upgrade.

value.description: Open upgrade-state code. Known values are listed in `x-omnivia-upgrade-states`; unknown values must be preserved.

target_version.description: Contract version the upgrade targets, when one is known.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation. Not a stable interface.

CompatibilityMetadata.title: CompatibilityMetadata
CompatibilityMetadata.description: The outcome of version negotiation: what was selected, what is supported, and what the caller must do next.

selected_api_version.description: API contract version the server applied to this request.

selected_workspace_version.description: Workspace format version the server applied to this request.

supported_api_versions.description: Inclusive API contract version window the server supports.

supported_workspace_versions.description: Inclusive workspace format version window the server supports.

status.description: Open compatibility status. Known values are listed in `x-omnivia-compatibility-statuses`; unknown values must be preserved.

upgrade_state.description: Upgrade posture implied by the negotiated versions.

deprecations.description: Deprecations that apply to the negotiated versions.

CapabilityRef.title: CapabilityRef
CapabilityRef.description: A concrete capability at a concrete version.

CapabilityRequirement.title: CapabilityRequirement
CapabilityRequirement.description: A capability the caller needs, at or above a minimum version.

minimum_version.description: Lowest capability version the caller can work with.

required.description: When true, an unmet requirement fails the request with `capability_not_granted`. When false, the caller degrades.

CapabilitySet.title: CapabilitySet
CapabilitySet.description: The three capability views a caller needs: what the server can do, what this caller is allowed, and the intersection actually usable. `effective` is always `supported` intersected with `granted`; it is never widened by a claim.

granted.description: Capabilities policy grants to this caller and workspace.

effective.description: Capabilities actually usable on this request: `supported` intersected with `granted`.

VersionCapabilityEnvelope.title: VersionCapabilityEnvelope
VersionCapabilityEnvelope.description: Everything a caller needs to reason about what this server accepted and what it can do. Returned on every response, success or error.

api_version.description: API contract version in force for this response.

server_version.description: Concrete server build version. Diagnostic only; never negotiate on it.

workspace_format_version.description: Workspace format version in force for this response.

compatibility.description: Negotiated version windows, status, upgrade posture, and deprecations.
